decisions.reason: The polymer concrete drain housing is a core installation component of the firm's compatible product families, and the investment already made in it gives management reason to keep it even though it has not been visible since 2019.
Floor-level shower drainage sits at the heart of the firm's announced accessible, low-profile direction, so management will persist with the line despite its limited visibility.
As the publicly presented flagship of the design-focused strategy, the designer shower drain carries the strongest commitment and the most need for justification, so dropping it is very unlikely.

The shower element with integrated slope fits the integrated renovation strategy, and weak results can still be blamed on temporary causes such as pandemic-related construction disruptions, so management keeps it.
The DallSafe backflow-protected basement drain was launched with a specific public announcement and its own page, a visible commitment that management will defend by keeping it.
